asc.concise_source: Verified unmodified official MATH reference solution; all gold-repaired references excluded and logged.
asc.verbose_source: Fresh Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct samples from the frozen calibration role only.

validation.source_selection: 64 hash-selected MATH development questions, without outcome filtering

tokenskip.selection: one assigned ratio per source question for training; all ratios only for compression validation

adaptations: Task-specific calibration for the unified main Qwen-7B teacher; does not claim an original ASC published-model reproduction.
Use 100 unique verified long-reference pairs from the frozen 400-question MATH calibration role; never use student or development questions for vector fitting.
Preserve CES mean response energy, full-vocabulary WikiText forward-KL, 3000 steps, and all registered optimizer/layer settings.
Reuse identical pinned WikiText training and held-out rows from the native-GSM check; mathematics rows and target teacher are new.
4K generation budget is twice the 2K proposal from the fixed 32-question unmodified-teacher diagnostic; retained cap hits and full dev scale curve must still be audited.
Native CoT boxed prompt is the same across fresh calibration, teacher forcing and development generation.
The 64 development questions are selected without correctness filtering; this stage cannot train a student or populate DAP/TokenSkip with official reference traces.
Use the frozen typed mathematics grader, preserving tuple order, interval endpoints and numerical bases.

calibration_generation.selection: first correct noncapped target-model candidate longer than reference; stable pool order; stop at 100 unique pairs

prompt_policy.question_template:
{question}
Please reason step by step, and put your final answer within \boxed{{}}.
prompt_policy.rationale: Published Section 5.1 uses standard CoT prompts for target-model verbose traces. Prior project prompts suppress native R1 verbosity; this is a separately frozen development fidelity check, not a recovered exact author prompt.
